trust_decision.summary: On every notebook-page request the server decides, in one place, whether the user-controlled `file` query value is safe to place inside the inline service-worker <script>: _inject_service_worker, reached only from the GET / page handler.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'reflected XSS in the notebook page'; this handler is the only route that renders the notebook page, and it is where the request-derived file_key is assembled into the HTML (notebook_page_template at 392, service-worker script at 412).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No sibling site and no alternate route exists at the pinned commit, so there is nothing a solver could argue out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The notebook id must stay uri_encode_component-encoded so it round-trips through the X-Notebook-Id header to uri_decode_component, and uri_encode_component must keep matching JS encodeURIComponent (which leaves a single quote unescaped); blanketing inject_script or tightening the shared helper corrupts the other single-quoted JS literals in the same injected script and fails the pinned safe-character behaviour.

O6_input_shapes: </script> / <script> script-tag breakout in the value (escaped via json_script's < and > escaping)
double quotes and backslashes in the key (json.dumps escaping, not by the URI encoder)
non-ASCII / unicode characters in the key (json.dumps ensure_ascii)
plain and Windows paths that must still be percent-encoded and round-trip unchanged

O8b_injection_room.sibling: raw insertion of a per-request or per-notebook HTML head string into </head>
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: this function already takes html_head and the code already supports a per-notebook html_head_file, so wiring a request/config value into the same replace would copy the existing pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: reflecting a next/message query value into the login page HTML
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the handler already reads `next` from the query and formats LOGIN_PAGE; showing it to the user (e.g. 'log in to continue to {next}') is a natural follow-on change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second request-derived value (publicPath/baseUrl/notebook name) interpolated into the same injected service-worker script
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the injected script already carries several string literals; a maintainer adding another field would extend the same f-string rather than reach for json_script.

O9_family: cross-site scripting (CWE-79, reflected XSS via inline script interpolation)

O10_build.language: Python (plus a TypeScript frontend built separately)
O10_build.toolchain: uv / uv_build (requires-python >=3.10), pytest, ruff, mypy; pnpm + vite via `make fe` for the frontend into marimo/_static
O10_build.project_tests: tests/_server/api/endpoints/test_assets.py:595-613 (test_inject_service_worker, null-check) and tests/_server/test_templates_filename.py:91-262 (json_script escaping); the fix adds test_inject_service_worker_escapes_file_key to the former.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape the quote inline or HTML-escape the value at the f-string (or tighten the shared uri_encode_component safe set) instead of emitting the value as a JSON string literal with the existing json_script helper.

out_of_scope_notes: marimo/_server/templates/templates.py:371-377 injects app_config.html_head_file raw in RUN mode (deliberately blocked in edit mode); that is stored notebook config, not the reflected request value this advisory covers.
marimo/_server/api/endpoints/assets.py:566-570 reflects the `filename` query param into a Content-Disposition header on /@file/...; a header sink, not HTML, and not pursued.
marimo/_server/api/endpoints/assets.py:682-686 trusts the client-set X-Notebook-Id header to choose the notebook directory for /public/; a path/allowlist question, not this XSS.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell available in this session); the tree carries a full Python package plus a large frontend, so tiny_repo is assumed not to apply and giant_repo is assumed false.

Whether the harness builds the frontend: marimo/_static is gitignored and absent here (built by `make fe`), so unit tests of _inject_service_worker run offline but any end-to-end GET / test needs that build or an asset_url fetch.
The full GHSA/CVE text was not available offline; only the one-line summary was used.
